objective: READ_ONLY: revisar tempcheques y turnos recientes de CIENFUEGOS SoftRestaurant para identificar la fecha operativa real del turno aun no cortado. No escribir, no resincronizar, no tocar Produccion.

queries.name: tempcheques_cienfuegos_resumen
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(date,fecha) AS fecha, COUNT(DISTINCT folio) AS cheques, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(total,0)>=ISNULL(propina,0) THEN ISNULL(total,0)-ISNULL(propina,0) ELSE ISNULL(total,0) END) AS ventas_sin_propina, SUM(ISNULL(propina,0)) AS propina, SUM(ISNULL(nopersonas,1)) AS pax, MIN(fecha) AS primera_cuenta, MAX(fecha) AS ultima_cuenta, MIN(cierre) AS primer_cierre_cuenta, MAX(cierre) AS ultimo_cierre_cuenta FROM tempcheques WHERE ISNULL(cancelado,0)=0 GROUP BY CONVERT(date,fecha) ORDER BY fecha DESC

queries.name: turnos_cienfuegos_recientes
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM turnos ORDER BY apertura DESC
